title: Unlocking Legal Protections: Homestead Tax Exemption Benefits
description:
Why do you need a Homestead Tax Exemption? 🏡 
It gives you legal protection! Creditors can’t foreclose on your home unless it’s for unpaid taxes or a mortgage. Other tax collectors can’t touch it if it's your primary residence! Keep your home safe and secure. 🔒
